decision: Do not nominate an H200 discriminator from this lane. The only source-complete exact candidate has a favorable point estimate, but it clears the 1% request gate by only 21.3 ms under unverified same-bandwidth and full-launch-credit assumptions. That is not a conservative bound.
next_action: Close this zero-GPU lane. Reopen only if independently collected exact-path counters or an already-authorized target-GPU measurement can bound fused shared-memory/reduction efficiency; this terminal does not request a bench.
